name: Simon Bickler
story: Archaeologist Simon Bickler's professional CV records a presentation at the Māori GIS Conference in Lower Hutt in October 2010. Its title was 60,000 Records and Counting: The Creation of the New Zealand Archaeological Association's ArchSite GIS Database. This confirms his presentation on archaeological GIS infrastructure, without establishing that he alone designed ArchSite or organised the conference.
